name: KAOS Crypto Research v1
dataset: checksum-verified Binance BTCUSDT ETHUSDT SOLUSDT five-second bars 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07
learned: three fixed 80-tree depth2 XGBoost models; development only; confidence .55/.60/.65; no parameter search
selection: validation minimum200 decided, two dates, two assets; positive pnl both dates; rank Wilson lower bound; if none eligible no final test; else freeze one best eligible candidate before final evaluation
final_success: minimum200 decided, two dates, two assets; win-rate Wilson lower bound above 55.56%; positive pnl both days; validation Bonferroni-adjusted binomial p<.05; delayed-entry and 1bp adverse price stress positive
fees_and_execution: binary spot-price proxy only; no observed broker payout, no spot transaction profitability claim
publication: always publish full validation table, selected rules and test result even when unsuccessful; never tune after seeing final result
